blurb: Guests take helicopter tours departing from Oceanside Airport or Desert Ironwoods Resort in Ocotillo Wells. Tours range from 10 to 65 minutes, flying over coastal landmarks like Oceanside Pier, La Jolla Cove, Mission Bay, and downtown San Diego, or desert landmarks like Blow Sand and Devil's Slide. Custom flights are available to tailor routes, flight times, and experiences.

quotes.author: Cara Ratajczak
quotes.text: Cara Ratajczak11 months agoI hired Zephyr Helicopters as a special gift for my daughter's 18th birthday. It was everything she expected, and more! My daughter chose her two siblings to join her, and all three of them had an unforgettable time flying along the San Diego coastline. If you're looking for a unique, memorable gift or just a fun adventure, I can't recommend Zephyr helicopters enough. Thank you Jacob for being so professional and focused on safety.

quotes.author: Jason Plough
quotes.text: Jason Plough11 months agoWe had an amazing time with our Zephyr Helicopter tour. He was friendly and informative and told us about all sorts of local things as we would fly over the locations. Always graciously took his time to answer our questions and point out things we were hoping to see. The flight was smooth and absolutely stunning views. We would definitely do again! Thank you so much!

quotes.author: Amy Ignaciak
quotes.text: Amy Ignaciak11 months agoWow what an experience!!! I am afraid of heights but my daughter isn’t and wanted to fly through the sky. So we booked and I can’t say enough what an amazing view and time we had. Jacob, the pilot was so assuring, professional and made me feel so safe. The views were breathtaking and it was an experience of a lifetime!! Will for sure be booking again!

quotes.author: Sarah Silveira
quotes.text: Sarah Silveira11 months agoI had such a great time on the helicopter ride with Jacob! He was friendly, informative, and fun to be with. He went out of his way to loop back and show us seals and dolphins. The helicopter itself was brand new and comfortable. I highly recommend!

quotes.author: Jackoby Crouch
quotes.text: Jackoby Crouch11 months agoWe had the BEST time. Our pilot Jacob was extremely accommodating, he navigated around some heavy fog and we were able to spot some dolphins! Very knowledgeable about the local landscapes and history as well. Highly recommend!

quotes.author: John Pfau
quotes.text: John Pfau12 months agoJacob the owner and pilot was very accommodating and pleasant to fly with. He answered all of our questions while in flight. It was a very pleasant flight. I would highly recommend a flight ✈️
